lms.scorm.title: Download a SCORM package
lms.scorm.intro: Put this simulation in any learning system (LMS) that takes SCORM. Participants play it inside the LMS, exactly as they would from a launch link, and the LMS records whether they completed it, their score and where they left off.
lms.scorm.from: The package is made from your draft as last saved: version {version}, {title}.
lms.scorm.version.label: LMS standard
lms.scorm.version.help: Ask your LMS team which one to use. SCORM 2004 also records each skill and saves a whole run; SCORM 1.2 saves less, so someone who leaves part way through may pick up again at the start of an earlier {unit, select, year {year} month {month} day {day} other {week}}.
lms.scorm.completion.label: Complete when
lms.scorm.completion.finish: The participant reaches the end of the simulation
lms.scorm.completion.periods: The participant has played a number of {unit, select, year {years} month {months} day {days} other {weeks}}
lms.scorm.completion.count: How many {unit, select, year {years} month {months} day {days} other {weeks}}, out of {total}
lms.scorm.pass.label: Pass when
lms.scorm.pass.none: No pass mark: completing is enough
lms.scorm.pass.score: The Leadership Score reaches a pass mark
lms.scorm.pass.scoreHelp: The LMS shows the Leadership Score out of 100. Pass or fail is decided once the participant completes.
lms.scorm.pass.level: The report's overall level reaches a level
lms.scorm.pass.levelHelp: Decided at the end of the simulation, from the report. Someone without enough evidence for an overall level does not pass.
lms.scorm.connected.label: Connect to iLead for full reports
lms.scorm.connected.help: Off (recommended to start): the package plays on its own, with nothing sent outside the LMS. The LMS gets completion, pass or fail and the score. On: each run is also sent to iLead, so you get the participant's full report and the group report. The package never holds passwords or keys; iLead recognises it by its package number.
lms.scorm.blocked: {count, plural, one {# issue stops} other {# issues stop}} the package, as they stop publishing. Fix them first.
lms.scorm.done: {standard} package downloaded: {title}, version {version}. Its fingerprint is {hash}; a Preview of the same saved draft has the same one.
lms.scorm.error.player: The participant player is not on this server, so the package cannot be made here. Ask your administrator for a full build of iLead.
lms.scorm.error.other: The package could not be made. {reason}
lms.player.loadFailed: This simulation could not start. Close it and open it again from your learning system. If it happens again, tell your administrator.
